role: independent source and negative testing only
requiredNegativeInputs: fixed target path disagreement or inherited HERMES_HOME injection
failed or returning exec never falls back to direct runtime
half-completed state.enter failure never invokes encode/exec
mutated launch metadata or database identity never produces writable owner
constructor/start/close uncertainty keeps lease and blocks retry, no forced registry prune
receipt source path cannot become executable/argv/env
scopeLimit: No root/mount/namespace/bootstrap/install or refused action retry. Tests must identify any doubles. Generic normal-user exec does not establish confined launch.
